description: This file implements an in-memory lease provider for development and testing within the Orleans framework. It includes classes and interfaces for managing leases, including acquisition, renewal, and release of leases, specifically designed for local and test scenarios, not production.

classes.name: InMemoryLeaseProvider
classes.description: Provides in-memory lease management for development/testing, implements ILeaseProvider.

classes.name: DevelopmentLeaseProviderGrain
classes.description: Stores lease information in memory as an Orleans grain, supporting lease acquire, release, renew, and reset operations.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Attempts to acquire leases for resources within a category, returns results asynchronously.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases acquired leases within a category.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Clears all stored leases, used to simulate loss or trigger rebalancing.
